backend.responseEnvelope: { success: boolean, message: string, data: object|array|null } — CRITICAL: pnidService.js's initial implementation documented this envelope here but FAILED to actually unwrap `.data` in the service functions themselves, so every consumer received the raw envelope instead of the real payload (e.g. clientFiles.uploads was always undefined since the real path is response.data.uploads). Fixed 2026-07-24 after the user supplied a live GET /clients/files response confirming the wrapping. All JSON-returning pnidService functions now unwrap via an internal `unwrap()` helper EXCEPT saveHighlightOptions and validateConnection, whose own doc samples prove they do NOT use this envelope (see their endpoint entries below). Three endpoints (startExtract, startOcr, convertPdfPreview) nest even deeper — after unwrapping `.data` the real payload is `{workspaceName, results: {...}}`, so job_id/images/images_folder live under `.results`, not the unwrapped top level; usePipeline.js and useProcessConfig.js were fixed to read `.results.job_id` / `.results.images` / `.results.images_folder` accordingly.
backend.authHeadersActuallySent: Authorization: Bearer <token> AND Cookie: access_token=<token> — injected globally by the proxy factory (see CLAUDE.md API rule 3), never per-route
backend.priorBackend: This route surface (/api/domain-configuration/pnid-workspace/[...path]) previously resolved to backend "PNID" (SERVICE_PNID_URL). Repointed to a NEW dedicated logical backend "PNID_WORKSPACE" per explicit user decision (2026-07-24): although both currently happen to be the same local dev host, PNID is still used, unchanged, by admin/cpcp's Assessment Matrix (cpcpService.js's PNID_BASE calls — assessment/matrix, run-pnid-agent, update-tag, verify-tag, add-tag, delete-tag), none of which appear in this refactored contract. Reusing PNID would have risked silently repointing that unrelated feature's host.

decisions.question: Does plant_code_id/plantCodeId in this contract mean the existing free-text client_name/[workspace] value (rename only), or the app's global Plant Selector (useApp().plantCode)?
decisions.answer: Global Plant Selector (useApp().plantCode), per explicit user choice. This replaced the entire per-feature workspace list/create/switch/delete UI and the [workspace] dynamic route segment across the whole domain-configuration/pnid admin feature — matching the precedent already executed for cpcp-configuration/workflow-diagram. Routes flattened: /admin/domain-configuration/pnid, /pnid/manage-files, /pnid/validate, /pnid/template-matching (no more /pnid/{name}/...).

decisions.question: Does 'Path params:' in the doc's Request Example mean a real URL path segment?
decisions.answer: Only when the Endpoint column itself shows a literal {placeholder} (e.g. /dataFolders/{folder_name}, /clients/{client_name}/files/{category}/{filename}, /kg_data/{client_name}/update, /clients/{client_name}/excelExists, /exportExcel, /finalCsv, /highlightOptions, /uploadToCdm). Every other 'Path params:' label with no matching {placeholder} in Endpoint is sent as a query param — same rule already confirmed for cpcp-configuration.

decisions.question: Two deletion endpoints exist: DELETE /clients and DELETE /dataFolders/{folder_name}. Which powers the UI's 'delete/reset this plant's data' action?
decisions.answer: DELETE /clients (pnidService.deleteClient) — matches this domain's own 'client' vocabulary for a full workspace/plant record more precisely than a lower-level raw-folder delete. DELETE /dataFolders/{folder_name} (pnidService.deleteDataFolder) is implemented but has no UI consumer — flag to product/backend if this mapping is wrong.

notes: plant code field naming is NOT uniform across this domain's endpoints: mix of snake_case plant_code_id and camelCase plantCodeId — implemented literally per the pasted doc, not normalized. apiClient.js's PLANT_CODE_KEYS guard already covers both variants (added during the cpcp-configuration migration).

LIVE-CONFIRMED CORRECTION (2026-07-24) — POST /upload: the doc documents the field as `plantCodeId` (camelCase), but the live backend rejected it with a FastAPI-style validation error `{success:false, message:"Validation failed", errors:[{field:"plant_code_id", message:"Field required"}]}`, i.e. it actually requires snake_case `plant_code_id`. pnidService.uploadWorkspaceFiles now sends BOTH `plant_code_id` (real, required) and `plantCodeId` (kept for any deployment still reading the old name). This is a real signal the doc's per-endpoint snake_case/camelCase choices are not 100% reliable — if other multipart/form endpoints (e.g. runTemplateMatch, which the doc also lists as `plantCodeId`) throw the same 'Field required' error live, apply the same fix there.

Also note the error envelope for a FastAPI-style validation failure is `{success, message, errors:[{field, message}]}` — NOT `{success, message, data}` as documented for successful responses. Error handling that only reads `data`/`detail` will miss this `errors` array.

RESOLVED (2026-07-27, user decision) — uploadToCdm's cdm_url: old contract sent a `plant_code` query param (a plant identifier) to POST /clients/{client}/upload-to-cdm; the new contract's POST /clients/{client_name}/uploadToCdm body wants `cdm_url` (an actual destination URL string), not a plant code. No per-plant UI source exists for this value, so pnidService.uploadToCdm now falls back to a fixed deployment-wide NEXT_PUBLIC_PNID_CDM_DESTINATION_URL env var (.env.local) when the caller omits cdmUrl — ValidateResultsPage.jsx's handleUploadToCdm still calls pnidService.uploadToCdm(plantCode) with cdmUrl omitted, letting the service apply the fallback. That env var was a PLACEHOLDER (REPLACE_WITH_REAL_CDM_DESTINATION_URL) until 2026-07-31, when a live 'Send to Staging' 400'd with "Request URL is missing an 'http://' or 'https://' protocol" — proof the backend was trying to use the placeholder string as a real outbound URL. User supplied the real value; NEXT_PUBLIC_PNID_CDM_DESTINATION_URL is now http://13.201.105.53:8181/p0_cdm/ in .env.local.

UNCONFIRMED — POST /ocrProcess (startOcr) doc body only shows { plant_code_id, pnid_selected_files }, omitting `pfd_selected_files` and `usable_area` (crop box) that the pre-refactor contract accepted. pnidService.startOcr still sends both defensively (extra JSON fields are typically harmless to FastAPI unless using a strict/extra='forbid' Pydantic model) — verify with backend whether PFD selection and the crop-box UI (ProcessConfigModal) still have any effect.

LIVE-CONFIRMED (2026-08-03) — POST /ocrProcess: `usable_area` is typed as a STRING, not an array. Sending the raw [x1, y1, x2, y2] number array returned `{success:false, message:"Validation failed", errors:[{field:"usable_area", message:"Input should be a valid string"}]}`. pnidService.startOcr now sends `usable_area: JSON.stringify([x1,y1,x2,y2])` and OMITS the key entirely when no crop box was drawn — matching the pre-refactor FormData contract, which did `form.append('usable_area', JSON.stringify([x1,y1,x2,y2]))` only inside an `if (cropBoxCoordinates)` guard. This also proves the field is NOT silently ignored despite being absent from the doc — the backend actively validates it, so the crop-box UI does reach the backend. Still unverified: whether the key is REQUIRED (omitting it has not produced a 'Field required' error so far) and whether `pfd_selected_files` has any effect.

UNCONFIRMED — ocr_excel_filename/document_path fields required by POST /compareAndClean, POST /highlightComponents/json, POST /highlight-components, POST /validateConnection, POST /highlightTagsCpcp have no old-contract equivalent. Best-effort derivations, grounded in the doc's own sample paths but not live-tested: (a) compareAndClean's document_path = the raw uploaded PDF's path (matches doc sample 'acme_refinery/uploaded files/pnid/PnID_Sheet_01.pdf'), sourced in usePipeline.js from the first selected P&ID/PFD file's `.path` at start(). (b) highlightComponents/json, highlight-components, validateConnection, highlightTagsCpcp's document_path = the currently-selected PREPROCESSED PAGE IMAGE path (matches doc sample 'new123/preprocess_files/pnid/PnID_/page_1.png'), sourced in useConnections.js from `selectedPageFile?.path`. (c) ocr_excel_filename in all of the above = the first non-'_raw' .xlsx file found in preprocessedFiles (getClientFiles' `preprocessed` array), via useConnections.js's `ocrExcelFilename()` helper and usePipeline.js's `cfgRef.current.ocrExcelPath` (captured from the OCR job's own result at completion).

RESOLVED (2026-07-27, user decision) — pdf_name required by GET/POST /clients/{client_name}/highlightOptions and POST /highlight-components /highlightComponents/json: defaults in useValidateData.js to `data.uploads.pnid[0]?.name` (the first raw uploaded P&ID PDF's filename), and now exposes the full `pnidUploads` list + `setPdfName`. When a plant has more than one uploaded P&ID PDF, PageSelector.jsx renders a 'P&ID Source Document' picker (hidden when there's only one) so the user can switch the active pdf_name manually — switching also clears activeConnection/highlightData/validationResult since a different source document has a different connection list.

GET /chatbot/chat (checkChatbotStatus)'s doc Request Example shows the same {plant_code_id, question, pdf_name} body as the POST row — almost certainly a copy-paste artifact for a GET status-poll endpoint. Implemented instead as query params {plant_code_id, task_id} (matching the async job-polling pattern used elsewhere in this doc, e.g. extractStatus/ocrStatus) — unconfirmed, no current UI consumer.

Knowledge Graph (/kg_data, /kg_data/{client_name}/update) and Chatbot (/chatbot/chat) are NEW additive endpoints on pnidService with no current UI consumer — added for contract completeness, matching the cpcp-configuration precedent. These are UNRELATED to the existing pnid/knowledge-graph/chat and pnid/knowledge-graph/update proxy routes (src/app/api/domain-configuration/pnid/knowledge-graph/*), which hit a completely different backend (KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH, /p1_knowledgegraph/graph/kg_chat and /p1/knowledgeGraph/graph/updateGraph) for the unrelated Ontology Generator KG Explorer chat feature.

Major structural change beyond API wiring: the entire [workspace] dynamic-route model was removed. Deleted: WorkspaceMenu.jsx (confirmed orphaned/unused before this change too), the workspace list/create/switch/delete UI in useWorkspace.js, the pnid_validated_workspace::<pid> and pnid_client_name localStorage bridges (useValidateData.js, useTemplateMatching.js, PidValidateView.jsx, validate/page.jsx). Routes moved: pnid/[workspace]/manage-files -> pnid/manage-files, pnid/[workspace]/validate -> pnid/validate, pnid/[workspace]/template-matching -> pnid/template-matching; pnid/[workspace]/page.jsx merged into pnid/page.jsx.

Reactivity fix: useValidateData.js and useTemplateMatching.js previously resolved their scoping value ONCE on mount (prop-or-localStorage, no re-run on change). Now both depend on plantCode and re-fetch when the global Plant Selector changes without a page navigation — a real correctness fix, not just a rename, since the old per-workspace URL model made this a non-issue (switching workspace always meant a URL/page change).

RESOLVED (2026-07-28, user-confirmed) — validate page file/page dropdowns were empty and the connection sidebar spun forever: useValidateData.js's original getClientFiles-based sourcing (data.preprocessed / data.uploads.pnid) was never confirmed against a live response and also silently swallowed fetch errors (empty catch block), so nothing rendered and no error surfaced either. Root cause was compounded by a structural bug: fetchHighlightOptions (which owns isLoading) only ran once pdfName resolved, so an empty/mismatched uploads list left isLoading stuck at its initial true forever. Fixed by re-sourcing the validate page's file/page selectors from two endpoints the user live-tested: checkExtractionFiles (file_name, ocr_excel -> pnidUploads + ocrExcelFilename) and getImagesList doc_type=pnid (pdf/folder_name/images[] -> preprocessedFiles). checkExtractionFiles's ocr_excel is a full backend-relative path; ocrExcelFilename derives its basename since highlightComponents/validateConnection's own live samples show ocr_excel_filename as a bare filename (e.g. 'ocr_result.xlsx'), not a path. fetchFileOptions now also sets isLoading(false) when a plant has no extracted files yet, and surfaces fetch errors via setErrorMessage instead of swallowing them.

Backend port note (2026-07-28, historical — dev instance only): the user's pasted Swagger/doc table showed some endpoints (getFile, clients/imagesList) resolving against http://127.0.0.1:8000, differing from this file's then-documented SERVICE_PNID_WORKSPACE_URL of http://127.0.0.1:4000. Verified locally: nothing listens on port 8000 (connection refused), while port 4000 was live and already returned a real 401-requires-auth response (not connection-refused) for an unauthenticated GET /clients/files — strong evidence 4000 was the correct, already-configured dev backend and 8000 was just wherever that Swagger UI instance happened to be hosted. .env.local was NOT changed. Superseded 2026-08-19 by the real deployed host (see envVarValue/gatewayPrefix above).

RESOLVED 2026-07-31 (live evidence) — uploadToCdm was briefly switched to path+query (/clients/{client_name}/uploadToCdm) per a freshly pasted doc table, conflicting with the 2026-07-28 diagrams.py-derived correction (flat path, body). A live 'Send to Staging' click immediately 404'd ({"detail":"Not Found"}) against the path+query version, proving that path doesn't exist on the backend. Reverted to flat path + body placement. See the uploadToCdm endpoint entry below.

LIVE-CONFIRMED CORRECTION (2026-07-31) — POST /clients/uploadToCdm: unlike every other endpoint in this domain (which uniformly use `plant_code_id`), this one endpoint's body validator requires the field literally named `plant_code` (no `_id` suffix) — confirmed via a live 400 `{success:false, message:'Validation failed', errors:[{field:'plant_code', message:'Field required'}]}` when only plant_code_id was sent. pnidService.uploadToCdm now sends both plant_code (real, required) and plant_code_id (kept defensively) — same defensive-both-fields pattern already used for uploadWorkspaceFiles's plantCodeId/plant_code_id mismatch above.

DEPLOYED 2026-08-19 — user shared the live Swagger link http://13.71.62.24/api/decisionops-pnid/swagger#/ for this domain ("pnid of domain configuration") plus cpcp-configuration's home page, explicitly distinguishing both from admin/cpcp's Assessment Matrix ("cpcp both are different"). Fetched the live openapi.json: same title "P&ID Validator API — Unified Storage", every path matches this file's documented contract 1:1, confirming this is the SAME backend as the 127.0.0.1:4000 dev instance, now deployed. BACKEND_PATHS.PNID_WORKSPACE updated from "" to "/api/decisionops-pnid" in src/app/api/_lib/backends.js; SERVICE_PNID_WORKSPACE_URL in .env.local was already the bare deployed host (http://13.71.62.24), no env change needed.
